title: Turn Around, Come Back
story: Slow to Anger, Great in Kindness
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Joel told the hungry, tired land
What the Lord had to say:
"Come back to Me with all your heart,
Not just a little way."

[Chorus]
He's slow to anger, full of love,
His kindness wide and deep;
So turning back is always safe,
A promise He will keep.

[Verse 2]
Back then they tore their clothes to show
How sorry they could be;
But He said, "Tear your heart instead,
And turn back home to Me."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Beau broke the little clay bird once
And hid the bits away;
His tummy hurt until he said,
"I broke it, Mom, today."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Whenever I have done a wrong,
I know just what to do:
I turn around with all my heart,
He's happy when I do.

[Chorus]
mood: Turning-around music. A light, steady walking pulse under the voice, like small feet that stopped on the path, turned, and are coming back up it, each step surer than the last. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeping the pulse, one soft upright bass note on the first beat of each line like a hand held out. Warm and open from the first verse, brightest at the end, when the turning back is done.
